response.sql: WITH elevated_ua AS (SELECT ID, HGB, APTT, PT FROM Laboratory WHERE UA > 3.9), patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) as avg_hgb, AVG(CASE WHEN APTT IS NOT NULL AND PT IS NOT NULL THEN APTT - PT ELSE NULL END) as avg_diff FROM elevated_ua GROUP BY ID) SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) as overall_avg_hgb, AVG(avg_diff) as overall_avg_diff FROM patient_averages
